questions.question: In your Project Accountant role with Jacobs Engineering Group, how did you perform weekly cash counts and monthly bank reconciliations, and what steps did you take when balances did not agree?
Describe the process you used to enter transactions and upload supporting documentation into WEBFCR. How did you ensure entries were complete, accurate, and properly supported?
You prepared monthly cash forecasts and budget requests. What information did you use, how did you develop the forecast, and how did you communicate expected cash needs to the home office?
Walk me through how you reviewed vendor or subcontractor invoices for approval and payment. What documentation, coding, and authorization checks did you perform?
In your subcontract accounting work, you assessed whether expenses were reasonable, allowable, and allocable. Can you provide an example of how you made that determination for a project expense?
What experience do you have preparing journal vouchers, including disbursement, cash, bank, and advance vouchers? How did you select the appropriate general ledger account coding?

This role requires monitoring accounts payable and receivable. Based on your experience tracking vendor invoices, payment confirmations, and wire-transfer vouchers, how would you prioritize and follow up on outstanding items?
Describe a weekly financial report you prepared for headquarters. What key information and supporting schedules did you include, and how did you verify the report before sending it?
How would you approach investigating an unexpected variance in a preliminary monthly income statement, balance sheet, or cash flow report before it is distributed to management?

This position involves managing multiple client relationships and explaining financial results clearly. How have you communicated with headquarters, contract managers, vendors, or other stakeholders when financial information or documentation was needed urgently?
